name: Germanic Archer
ac_note: hide armor + half cover from boulders
notes: CR 1/4. Shortbow. Behind boulders in zone 9 (half cover: +2 AC, +2 Dex saves). Suppression fire during Phase 1-2. Switches to seax if engaged in melee.
gm_notes: Session 2 raid, Phase 1-2. Four archers positioned behind the boulder clusters in zone 9 exterior. Their job is suppression -- keep defenders' heads below the crenellations while the spearmen advance and the ladders go up. Half cover from boulders: AC 15 effective, +2 to Dex saves. Archers do NOT advance. If the wall falls they flee into the treeline. They are not here to die -- they are here to make defenders duck.
